# Auto-fix gemini CLI if it breaks (improved version)
fix_gemini_cli() {
    local gemini_source="/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/lib/node_modules/@google/gemini-cli/dist/index.js"
    local gemini_target="/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/gemini"
    
    # Check if source exists and is executable
    if [ -f "$gemini_source" ] && [ -x "$gemini_source" ]; then
        # Check if target exists and is correct
        if [ ! -L "$gemini_target" ] || [ "$(readlink "$gemini_target")" != "$gemini_source" ]; then
            echo "Fixing gemini CLI symlink..."
            ln -sf "$gemini_source" "$gemini_target"
        fi
    else
        # Source doesn't exist or isn't executable - check if gemini is installed
        if ! npm list -g @google/gemini-cli >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Warning: @google/gemini-cli is not installed globally. Install it with: npm install -g @google/gemini-cli"
        else
            echo "Warning: gemini-cli is installed but the executable is missing or not executable"
        fi
        # Remove broken symlink if it exists
        [ -L "$gemini_target" ] && rm -f "$gemini_target"
    fi
}

# Run the fix function
fix_gemini_cli

# ── Session turn logging (Bleak infra) ──────────────────────────────────────
_COMM_LOG="$HOME/gemini_sync/comm_log.txt"
_log_start_turn() {
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - START TURN - $(whoami) - $(pwd)" >> "$_COMM_LOG"
}
_log_end_turn() {
    local EXIT_CODE=$?
    echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - END TURN - $(whoami) - Last exit: $EXIT_CODE" >> "$_COMM_LOG"
}
trap '_log_start_turn' DEBUG 2>/dev/null || true
PROMPT_COMMAND="_log_end_turn${PROMPT_COMMAND:+; $PROMPT_COMMAND}"
